title: 2026 GB F-gas non-GB representative QA controls

sources.title: Applying for quota to produce or import F gas
Incumbent F gas quota holders and authorisation managers in Great Britain

facts.source_fact: An organisation based outside Great Britain and Northern Ireland that wants GB quota must have a representative meeting the guidance conditions.
The representative must be a company based in Great Britain or Northern Ireland.
The representative is responsible for following F-gas regulations for the represented organisation.
Representative details are supplied during registration on the F-gas service.
The represented organisation's own details are also required.
A representative arrangement does not itself create quota.
Quota application requirements still apply after representative registration.
GB quota rules are distinct from EU quota rules.
Published incumbent-holder entries may identify represented overseas entities, but inclusion does not establish an emissions quantity.
Use current guidance status rather than treating representation as a parcel or installation measurement.
